propositions: DET floor must block epic close when an open or in-progress bug records a caused_by edge targeting the epic or any of its descendants, with a teaching message.

Candidate filter identifies open/in-progress bugs created after the epic's first open→in_progress STATUS transition (including retired events) OR linked to the epic subtree via any relation/any depth; maximum 32 candidates evaluated with overflow recorded.

Haiku screen delivers forced-choice A/B/C verdicts (defect-in-deliverable / pre-existing-same-subsystem / unrelated) via a registered output schema with normalizing validator, riding model-class config and cache settings, warm-then-fan-out orchestration, forwarding up to 8 compact candidates into the fenced context.

Verifier blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects per store-grounded disposition rule: (a) supersedes or duplicates link to epic subtree or successor, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose; bare out-of-scope or close_class do not satisfy.

Screen failure (run_verify=False) degrades to open with logged reason; DET floor is hard-blocking tier; all regression fixtures (must-block: 30a2, 5b09; must-pass: 30d3, e6a0, c8ed; not-flagged: 5e94, 22f5) pass live operator-attested calibration.
Completion_sidecar records full screen tally per bug with verdicts, citations, and unevaluated-overflow count for audit and FN calibration.
